cards.trigger: agent marks a unit INTEGRATED/PASS while its own attached data says pass:false
signature: verdict field disagrees with pass field in the same object
cards.approach: batch tool integration; report a verdict alongside a pass flag and detail block
cards.outcome: would have shipped a false green

cards.trigger: top-level CLEAN/all_pass:true wrapping a nested BLOCKED unit that carries pass:true
signature: nested contradiction hidden by nesting depth
cards.approach: aggregate many sub-results into one summary verdict
cards.caught_by: linter walks every object, not just the root

cards.trigger: a metric is correlated against a quantity that is an algebraic function of the same input, then reported as an independent coupling
signature: driver baked into the thing it is correlated with
cards.approach: prove X drives Y by correlating X against distance-from-X-off, with X inside the definition of the distance
cards.caught_by: adversarial audit: erase X, the correlate does not move independently
cards.outcome: 0.93 correlation that means nothing; a decorative >0.3 gate

cards.trigger: an ablation control re-runs with the ablated and non-ablated paths made identical, so the difference is 0 by construction
signature: control compares a state to itself
gate checks a structurally-zero quantity < epsilon
cards.approach: show removing a component matters by trace-distance between with and without, where both use the same generators under ablation
cards.caught_by: read the control code path, not the number

cards.trigger: a predictor's target is computed from the same features that feed the predictor
cards.approach: score belief/prediction where the ground-truth target is a function of the readout the model also consumes
cards.caught_by: trace the target's provenance to first principles

cards.trigger: a score is reported against chance (0.5) while the honest majority-class baseline is far higher
cards.approach: report accuracy vs chance without the majority-class or null baseline beside it
cards.caught_by: linter: any chance-comparison must carry a majority[path]/twin baseline
cards.outcome: 0.97 vs 0.5 looked great; majority baseline was 0.87

cards.trigger: an independent referee recomputes the same closed-form the primary computed, gets exact agreement, and it is reported as cross-validation
signature: the load-bearing dynamical quantity was never refereed
cards.approach: have a second runtime confirm a value by evaluating the same formula
cards.caught_by: check the referee recomputes the dynamical quantity, not the closed form
cards.outcome: decorative referee; real quantity differed in sign

cards.trigger: an empty object[path]/string is submitted in a provenance field to satisfy an evidence requirement
cards.approach: attach a raw[path]/evidence key with no content to pass an evidence check
cards.outcome: claim admitted with no actual evidence

cards.trigger: a recompute contract declares a tolerance far larger than the claim, so any value passes
cards.approach: declare a self-check with a tolerance wide enough that it cannot fail
cards.caught_by: tolerance ceiling: tol capped at a fraction of the claim magnitude

cards.trigger: a verdict outside the agreed vocabulary is used to dodge the verdict/pass consistency map
cards.approach: emit a verdict like TOTALLY_FINE that no rule knows how to score
cards.caught_by: strict mode: an uncheckable verdict is a rejected verdict
cards.outcome: claim slips past the consistency check

cards.trigger: agent builds a new implementation of something that already exists because it did not search first
cards.approach: start a task by building, when a spec or implementation already exists in the estate
cards.caught_by: admission gate: mandatory search receipt + near-duplicate detection before create

cards.trigger: an evaluator invents problems on clean artifacts to meet an implicit demand to find problems
cards.approach: ask an LLM to find problems; it produces some regardless of whether any exist
cards.caught_by: evalcheck: fabrication rate against a sealed known-clean deck
cards.outcome: noise treated as signal; wasted review

cards.trigger: driving stage admission by a single summary entropy instead of typed constraints
cards.approach: use von Neumann entropy alone as the organizing/admission variable
cards.caught_by: negative sim: fingerprint distinctness drops below the 16/16 baseline
cards.outcome: known dead end; typed constraints are load-bearing

cards.trigger: projecting generators to a commuting family to simplify
cards.approach: assume generators can be made to commute without losing the phenomenon
cards.caught_by: negative sim: flux goes exactly to 0
cards.outcome: known dead end; non-commutation is the source of the effect

cards.trigger: a gate or evaluator is tested only with cases it should reject (or only cases it should pass)
signature: always-reject gate passes its own suite
cards.approach: validate a checker with a suite of only-bad or only-good examples
cards.outcome: an always-yes or always-no checker certified as working
